You see a white pearl.
It weighs 0.20 oz.

    Notes

    You can dig white pearls at Vigintia's treasure hunting zone.
    It looks the same as the Orichalcum Pearl. Reward in the White Pearl Quest, Berserker Treasure Quest, Alawar's Vault Quest and the Skull of Ratha Quest. Needed for a seal in The Queen of the Banshees Quest
